race.description: Fundraisers At Angle Park (N/P) Tg 5+W Series 3 F
race.comment: LIFE'S A JOURNEY (1) was an all the way winner two back but last start drifted back and wound up strongly to finish a 3 length third at this track (20.17). Goes well out of this box with a win and two minor placings. Top prospect. ELLA'S DESTINY (2) has some solid form under her belt and proved too strong last time to win by 2.5 lengths at this track in a handy 19.95 beating Wirrulla Harry. Bold showing expected again. I'M MY DESIGN (4) hit the ground running last start and was never headed (19.96) at this track in Other over 342m. Has a solid record from this box including four wins and a minor placing. Likely to be in the finish. RUSSO (7) has strong claims after a top-three finish last time out.
